Brief review 2026-09-20 (Indoor slippers creative hub) — this brief has an error the editor must know about:
1. The hook `Finns den i 47?` fails the three-question test: a question cannot be true or false. Before upload: make the size range the headline (`Herr 40–47, khaki eller svart.`) with 47 highlighted in the size graphic, and drop the question.
Fix before production. If the ad is already live, apply it to the next version — nothing is paused. Status unchanged.
